headline: Congress named a Richmond, California post office building after Harold D. McCraw, Sr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1025 Nevin Avenue in Richmond, California, as the "Harold D. McCraw, Sr., Post Office Building." It only changes the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 6, 2018, and the new name took effect on that date.
